findings.description: The KMS key does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so automatic annual key rotation is disabled by default, increasing the risk associated with long-lived key material used to protect audit trail data.

No key_policy is defined for the KMS key, so it falls back to the default AWS-managed policy that grants full access to the entire account (root ARN with kms:* ), which is overly permissive for a key protecting sensitive audit trail data and violates least privilege.
